title: Superpolynomial worst-case trace sample lower bounds
exact_target: For each fixed deletion probability $q\in(0,1)$ and each fixed positive reconstruction success probability, is worst-case reconstruction of binary strings of length $n$ from deletion traces required to use at least $n^{c\log\log n}$ samples, for some $c>0$ and every sufficiently large $n$?
